# AIS-EVAL-07

**Is abstention evaluated, with questions the sources cannot answer in the test set, and the rate of answering them bounded?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | EVAL: Evaluation as evidence |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.ai.evals`, `elements.ai.grounding` |

## Why it matters

A test set made only of answerable questions cannot measure the costliest error of a grounded assistant, which is answering when it should decline. Without unanswerable and out-of-scope questions, precision is inflated by construction.

## Rule

Every generative ai facet with grounding has an eval whose positive_class is answering and whose errors.false_positive is answering a question the grounding cannot support. A reviewer checks that the test set holds enough unanswerable and out-of-scope questions to measure that rate.

## Sources

- NIST AI 600-1, Generative AI Profile (2024) (`nist-600-1`)
- Microsoft, Copilot Studio agent evaluation and its test methods (2026) (`cs-eval`)
- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026 (3 August 2026) (`owasp-llm`)
